source.name: Measured values (an article outside the archive)
Measured values (an article outside the archive)
measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 27 measured values (27 from the ThermoML Archive), 273.11-412.11 K, max deviation 2.3 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Negadi 2014 +0.01 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (1 values, 11-11 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 1.1 %.
